# FH-matui

FH-matui is a comprehensive Material Design UI component library built with nbdev for FastHTML applications. It provides a complete set of pre-built, composable Material Design 3 components that enable developers to create modern, responsive web interfaces entirely in Python with zero JavaScript required.

Here are some of FH-matui's features:
- **Material Design 3**: Modern UI components following Google's latest design language and best practices.
- **Zero JavaScript**: Build fully interactive web applications entirely in Python using FastHTML.
- **Responsive by Default**: Mobile-first design with automatic breakpoint handling and adaptive layouts.
- **Dark Mode Support**: Built-in light/dark theme support with 15+ color schemes (red, pink, purple, indigo, blue, cyan, teal, green, lime, yellow, amber, orange, deep-orange, brown).
- **Composable APIs**: Chainable styling methods (ButtonT, AT, BeerCssChain) for fluent component customization.
- **Full-Featured Data Tables**: DataTable and DataTableResource components with pagination, search, sorting, and complete CRUD operations.
- **Fully Documented**: Every module is automatically documented from literate programming notebooks with executable examples.

## Foundation & Theming
- [Foundations](_proc/00_foundations.html.md): Base utilities (VEnum, stringify, type conversion, helpers) and BeerCSS integration.
- [Core Theming](_proc/01_core.html.md): Theme system with MatTheme fluent API, BeerCssChain styling, and CDN configuration.

## UI Building Blocks
- [Components](_proc/02_components.html.md): Comprehensive Material Design component library including Buttons, Cards, Forms, Modals, Navigation, Icons, Grids, Tables, and Typography.

## Data Management
- [Data Tables](_proc/05_datatable.html.md): Advanced DataTable and DataTableResource for paginated tables with search, sort, and CRUD operations.

## Page Templates
- [App Pages](_proc/03_app_pages.html.md): Pre-built authenticated application layouts including LoginScreen and Dashboard patterns.
- [Web Pages](_proc/04_web_pages.html.md): Landing page and marketing components including Hero, Features, Pricing, FAQ, and complete Landing page compositions.
